source.workingTree: Verified uncommitted runtime, native binding, fixture and CI changes on the foundation HEAD. The fingerprint identifies the actual selected working-tree bytes, including tests and configuration; this is not a future commit SHA.

fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of a UTF-8 manifest: one line per selected file, lowercase SHA-256(file bytes), two ASCII spaces, repo-relative path, LF; unique paths sorted by JavaScript default string ordering.
fingerprint.selection: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- <pathspecs>; keep existing files and remove excludedPaths. This includes tracked and non-ignored untracked files. Evidence itself is excluded to avoid self-reference; the six research/planning reports are outside all selected paths.

environment.browserInstallation: Existing local Playwright browser installation; no local Linux --with-deps installation is claimed. CI installs Chromium with --with-deps.

acceptanceMatrix.status: Both production-built installed browser verifiers passed against this source fingerprint.
scenarios: held partial DOM update and Stop/native response close

notificationAssertions.limit: Behavioral counts, not render/paint or performance measurements.

cleanup.assertions: Unmount removes component controls; explicit app disposal resolves; post-disposal submit resolves aborted without extra I/O. Held SSE waits for the native response-close handshake.
cleanup.resources: Browser context, browser, held responses and server connections close in finally; verifier temporary install/bundle directories are removed in finally, including assertion failures.
cleanup.processes: Both verifier processes exited 0 after awaited finally cleanup of contexts, browsers and HTTP servers.

inventory.scope: Existing 16-library inventory only. Core/native package public contracts are checked separately. T01-T39 assignments are retained; only touched bounded subsets are in-progress.

ci.deploymentGuards: Existing main-ref and push-event guards preserved.
ci.runtimeEnvironment: Isolated Node Vitest config, no Angular setup/plugins.
ci.chromium: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium precedes both packed browser calls.
ci.builtScan: Production legacy builds precede emitted boundary scan.

runtimePolicy.explicitOptIn: Positive clientOptions.maxRetries enables SDK retries. Custom transports own their retry policy; no global no-retry guarantee is claimed.
runtimePolicy.recovery: Uncertain failures use read-only reconciliation without implicit resubmission.
runtimePolicy.canonicalTools: Canonical updates remove or replace pending tool references for the same assistant message, retain calls belonging to other messages, and preserve completed results; ownership is rechecked across pending async execution boundaries.

packageDiagnostics.limits: Installed files, optional lock locations, development root-import probes and full production apps are separate diagnostics. App bundles include the staged SDK. These are not performance benchmarks or comparable framework overhead measurements.
